description:
Java Developer – Identity & Access Management (IAM), #1132 

 Clearance:  U.S. Citizenship is required . Must be able to obtain a public trust clearance.    

 On site in Tysons Corner, VA 3 days per week   

 Dev Technology Group is looking for a Java Developer to support a project to plan and implement Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for web-based applications as part of Operations & Maintenance (O&M) for a federal government client. The ideal candidate will have relevant development experience, understanding of Identity & Access Management (IAM), strong collaboration and communication skills, and the ability to manage complex work activities in a deadline-driven environment. This is a great opportunity to work on mission-critical systems that provide clear value to end users and our federal government clients.   

 Summary   

 In collaboration with the Project Manager, Development Lead, and incumbent team members, the Software Developer will help to plan, design, and prototype the implementation of secure user authentication mechanisms for web-based applications. The primary focus of this role is to deliver a robust MFA solution leveraging industry available and a customer preferred identity provider (IdP) solution.   

 Required Education, Experience, and Skills:    

 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field with five (5) or more years of relevant experience in an Enterprise IT environment OR No Bachelor’s Degree with seven (7) or more years of relevant experience in an Enterprise IT environment    

 
 
 Multi-year proficiency in application development with one or more languages: JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js, React, Angular), Java / Spring Boot   

 Strong Java development experience 

 
 
 Experience with identity and access management and single sign-on, preferably with Microsoft Entra ID   

 
 
 Project experience developing and integrating user authentication workflow with web-based applications, for example Spring security     

 
 
 Excellent communication skills (both verbal and written) plus active listening skills to collaborate with a large cross functional team   

 
 
 Software delivery using the Agile Scrum or Kanban methodology via Jira    

 
 Preferred Education, Experience, and Skills:   

 
 Knowledge and implementation of MFA solutions, specifically IdP’s AWS Cognito, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and/or Login.gov    

 
 
 Knowledge and management of AWS GovCloud services, preferable Cognito, Lambda, S3, EC2, and API Gateway    

 
 
 Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD pipelines, automated builds, containerized environments, and version control using Jenkins or a similar tool   

 
 
 Understanding of tokens, authentication and authorization and best secure coding practices    

 
 
 Familiarity with implementing phishing-resistant MFA protocols, including PIV/CAC integration or authentication standards    

 
 
 Experience building and integrating RESTful APIs    

 
 
 Experience implementing password policies and account recovery flows    

 
 
 AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Developer or Solutions Architect)    

 
  

 " Our estimated salary range for this position is $100,000 - $150,000, this presented salary range is not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Offered salary is based on experience, geographic location, and possibly contractual requirements as appropriate to the role. *Salary could fall outside of this range. " 

  

  

   

  

  

   
 Who We Are 

 Dev Technology is a growing IT company with an employee-centric culture that works on mission-critical projects for the federal government. We partner with our federal customers to deliver technology services and solutions, and to drive our client’s missions forward through innovation. We use Agile and DevSecOps  principles to provide services including application development, biometrics and identity management, cloud and infrastructure optimization, IT and legacy modernization, and data management.     

 As a Washington Post Top Workplace award winner for the past THIRTEEN years in a row, the Top Workplaces USA for the past five years, and a recipient of the Companies As Responsive Employers (CARE) Award for the past six years, Dev Technology employees enjoy:    

 
 Generous and flexible time-off policy 

 Flexible work schedules and telework options, including remote work availability for eligible projects 

 Career development opportunities including a mentorship program, technical and management training through Dev University, hands-on learning through DevLab, tuition reimbursement, and paid training opportunities 

 Industry-leading benefits including a choice of two health plans that include dental and vision, flexible spending account, commuter benefits, life insurance, and more 

 401K matching with a 5% matching contribution 

 Regular team and company social events including our annual party, happy hours, fitness challenges, and more   

 A focus on community engagement including company wide support activities, employer match for donations, and time off for volunteer efforts 

 To learn more about working at Dev Technology, visit Working At Dev Technology Group 

 
  

 Equal Opportunity Employer / Individuals with Disabilities / Protected Veterans 

 

  

  

  

  

 Dev Technology Group operates in the following states: AL, AR, AZ, CO, DC, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, MD, MA, ME, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, NJ, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WV.
